rows.description: EU Finance Ministers Meetings are attended by Finance Ministers from the 28 EU member states. Relevant European Commissioners also participate in meetings. They discuss a wide range of financial issues, such as euro support mechanisms and government finances and are responsible for EU policy in three main areas: economic policy, taxation  issues and the regulation of financial services.
Luis de Guindos, Vice-President of the European Central Bank, is set to speak. His speeches often contain indications on the future possible direction of monetary policy.
